citation.title: Outcomes of One-Piece and Two-Piece Dental Implants After 15–17 Years: Follow-Up of a Randomized Clinical Trial
citation.authors: Pirc M, Pala K, Rusch F, Jung RE, Thoma DS, Balmer M
citation.journal: Clinical Implant Dentistry and Related Research

s_design.anchor: Long-term (15–17-year) follow-up of a randomized clinical trial (THERAPY RCT row, 85)
s_design.evidence_quote: This study represents the 15–17-year follow-up of a previously conducted randomized clinical trial

domains.evidence_quote: Randomization was performed using a computer-generated
domains.note: Sequence generation is described. Allocation concealment is not mentioned anywhere in Methods or Results, and the original protocol is deferred to earlier publications. The domain is described with one element absent, so it is rated some_concerns rather than high. The text does not state that allocation was unconcealed, so the 3b-i threshold does not apply.

domains.evidence_quote: the clinical protocol allowed a certain degree of
domains.note: Placement depth, augmentation, healing protocol (left to the surgeon's decision) and restoration type varied within arms. Analysis is on available cases and is not described as intention-to-treat. The domain is addressed only partially.

21 of 60 patients (56 implants) were lost before the final visit and missing data were not imputed. Completers were compared with dropouts on baseline characteristics. The domain is addressed, but substantial attrition remains.

domains.evidence_quote: blinding of the clinical examiners during follow-up examinations was not feasible
domains.note: Standardized clinical and radiographic protocols are described, with radiographs calibrated against the implant thread distance. Examiners were unblinded. The domain is described with one element absent, so it is rated some_concerns.

The cited identifier is the local ethics committee number given in Study Design, not a registry entry predating the trial, and no prespecified analysis plan is described. CAL is listed among the outcome measures but is not reported in the Results or the tables.

penalties.evidence_quote: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
penalties.note: CoI is declared and the study was self-funded by a university clinic, which is not a manufacturer.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.evidence_quote: number of patients available for the final analysis limited the
penalties.note: No power calculation or sample size justification appears anywhere in Methods or Statistical Analysis. The authors themselves acknowledge limited power. Scaled: 5 × 85 ÷ 100 = 4.25, rounded to 4.

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome requires
penalties.evidence_quote: with a mean follow-up of 16.4 ± 1.1 years
penalties.note: Follow-up is adequate for survival and complication claims.

fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۴۳ از ۱۰۰ است، در باند C (شواهد محدود) برای پرسش THERAPY.
interpretation_fa: این یک RCT با پیگیری ۱۵ تا ۱۷ ساله است. اما ریزش حدود یک‌سوم بیماران، نبود blinding ارزیاب و تحلیل عمدتاً توصیفی، قطعیت مقایسه‌ی دو سیستم را پایین می‌آورد. مقاله می‌گوید داده‌های بیش از ۱۰ سال پیگیری در این زمینه اندک است و این پیگیری ۱۵ تا ۱۷ ساله بقا و عوارض تکنیکال دو سیستم را گزارش می‌کند. Brånemark نسل قدیمی two-piece است و نتایج مستقیماً به سیستم‌های امروزی با platform switching تعمیم نمی‌یابد.
